name: River Captain
shortDescription: The adult who keeps other people's cargo at the black mooring.
lookDescription: An otter in a buttoned river coat waits at the black mooring as if the camp were a school.
examineDescription: A grown otter in a short river coat, brass buttons done up to the throat. He sits on a crate with a ledger open across one knee and does not stand when you come in. His coat is dry. Everything else in this camp has been out in the rain all night. Marram says a trained Collegian can face him alone, and that bringing a classmate is the smarter of the two plans.
lockNarration: The camp goes quiet the way a held boat goes quiet.
victoryNarration: The River Captain's coat comes off the rail. The mooring is only tar and willow again. The cargo can go home.
